items.description: Sales Order Processing for Sales Kits

story.headline: Take a customer order for a bundled kit, ship it, and bill it — as one clean flow.
outcomeBullets: One order captures the whole kit, so nothing is missed at picking
Warehouse and finance work from the same order, not re-keyed copies
The customer is invoiced automatically once the goods leave
integrationNotes: Delivery and billing hand off to inventory and finance without re-entry
story.sourceAttribution: SAP Best Practices, S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2602

chapters.title: Capture the customer's order
chapters.summary: A sales colleague records what the customer wants, including every item in the kit, in a single order.
chapters.benefitNote: One order for the whole kit means fewer missed lines later.

chapters.title: Prepare and ship the goods
chapters.summary: The warehouse turns the order into a delivery, picks the items, and confirms they have left the building.
chapters.benefitNote: Stock levels update the moment goods are issued.

chapters.title: Invoice the customer
chapters.summary: Once the goods are gone, the system raises the customer's invoice from the same order — no re-keying.
chapters.benefitNote: Billing reads the shipped order directly, so what you ship is what you bill.

story.headline: Ask several suppliers for a price, compare their quotes, and award the business — with a full trail.
outcomeBullets: Every supplier is asked the same thing, so quotes are comparable
The award decision is recorded and auditable
The winning quote becomes an order without re-typing
integrationNotes: The awarded quote carries straight into a purchase order
story.sourceAttribution: SAP Best Practices, S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2602

chapters.title: Ask suppliers for a price
chapters.summary: A buyer sends the same request out to the chosen suppliers so their answers can be compared fairly.
chapters.benefitNote: Asking everyone the same question keeps quotes comparable.

chapters.title: Compare and award
chapters.summary: The buyer lines up the quotes side by side and awards the business to the best one.
chapters.benefitNote: A recorded comparison makes the award defensible later.

chapters.title: Turn the award into an order
chapters.summary: The winning quote is converted into the follow-on purchasing document, ready to buy.
chapters.benefitNote: No re-keying between the award and the order.

story.headline: Buy the materials production needs — from the trigger, to the order, to a compliant e-invoice.
outcomeBullets: Purchase orders raise themselves from the demand signal
The e-invoice is submitted in the country's required format
Buyers only step in on the exceptions
integrationNotes: Local e-invoicing rules are handled in the submission step
story.sourceAttribution: SAP Best Practices, S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2602

chapters.title: Trigger the material purchase
chapters.summary: Demand for a stocked material starts the buying process.

chapters.title: Raise the purchase order automatically
chapters.summary: The request becomes a purchase order without a buyer re-typing it.
chapters.benefitNote: Touchless ordering frees buyers for the exceptions.

chapters.title: Submit the compliant e-invoice
chapters.summary: The supplier invoice is submitted electronically in the format the tax authority requires.
chapters.benefitNote: Local compliance is built into the flow, not bolted on.

story.headline: Deliver a project across two of your own companies and settle the value between them cleanly.
outcomeBullets: Time and travel are captured against the right project
The two entities settle at the agreed intercompany price
One flow keeps both companies' books consistent
integrationNotes: Time, travel expense, and billing feed the intercompany settlement
story.sourceAttribution: SAP Best Practices, S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2602

chapters.title: Set up the intercompany project
chapters.summary: The receiving company confirms the intercompany order and stands up the project the work will run against.

chapters.title: Record the work and its costs
chapters.summary: People log their time to the project, and travel costs are captured as supplier invoices.
chapters.benefitNote: Costs land on the project as they happen, not at month-end.

chapters.title: Settle between the companies
chapters.summary: The delivering company bills the receiving one at the agreed intercompany terms.
chapters.benefitNote: Both entities' books stay consistent automatically.

items.description: Customer Returns with Direct Shipment from Customer to Supplier

story.headline: Handle a customer return that goes straight back to the supplier, and get everyone refunded correctly.
outcomeBullets: The return is logged once and drives everything after it
The supplier credit and the customer refund stay in step
You can refund by credit note or by replacement
integrationNotes: The customer refund and the supplier credit are reconciled in one flow
story.sourceAttribution: SAP Best Practices, S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2602

chapters.title: Log the customer return
chapters.summary: The return is recorded, capturing what is coming back and why.

chapters.title: Recover from the supplier and decide the refund
chapters.summary: A credit is raised against the supplier, and the refund due to the customer is worked out and reviewed.
chapters.benefitNote: Supplier recovery and customer refund are kept in step.

chapters.title: Refund the customer
chapters.summary: The customer is made whole — either with a credit note or a replacement product.
chapters.benefitNote: One process supports both refund and replacement.
